intent.proves: At least one page has a meta title or meta description.

bindings.reason: search_pages matches text against menu text or SEO title but returns no metadata projection.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page WHERE PageDeleted = 0 AND (ISNULL(PageMetaTitle, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(CAST(PageDescription AS nvarchar(max)), N'') <> N'')
